question:
**Select the most appropriate one word to substitute the given group of words.**

one who lives on others
solution:
The correct answer is '**parasite**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**parasite**'.
 
• It means 'a plant or an animal that lives in or on another plant or animal and gets its food from it. Parasites sometimes cause disease'. (परजीवी वनस्‍पति या जंतु, ये रोगों का कारण भी बन सकते हैं)
 
 
• *Example: Many diseases are caused by **parasites**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *parasite.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **hypocrite**: a person who pretends to have moral standards or opinions which he/she does not really have. Hypocrites say one thing and do another. [(वास्‍तविकता के विपरीत) उच्‍च नैतिक मानदंड और व्‍यवहार का ढोंग रचने वाला व्‍यक्ति; पाखंडी, ढोंगी]
 
• **shrewd**: able to make good decisions because you understand a situation well. [(स्थिति को समझ लेने के कारण) उचित निर्णय करने में समर्थ; समझदार, सयाना, चतुर]
 
• **flatterer**: a person who lavishes praise, often insincerely; a sycophant. (एक व्यक्ति जो प्रशंसा करता है, अक्सर ईमानदारी से; एक चाटुकार)
